source_of_truth: Use Case Specifications v1.0 (Related Workflow columns)
note: Design only — no production code consulted. Workflow ids from UC specs: BW-LMS-01..05 (basis), CW-LMS-01, CW-LMS-02 (composite).

workflows.name: Student submits assignment
workflows.trigger: student chooses Submit before due date

workflows.name: Faculty releases grades
workflows.outcome: draft grades become Released and visible
workflows.guard: draft remains hidden; TA grading alone does not release

workflows.name: Composite: material lifecycle
workflows.steps: create draft -> schedule -> scheduled release -> published -> student views

workflows.name: Composite: grade lifecycle
workflows.steps: submit -> grade (draft) -> release -> student views read-only -> optional change audit
